description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and classes related to broadcast and tuner configurations within the WPEFramework. It includes definitions for sections, monitor interfaces, iterator templates, BCD conversion, spectral inversion, modulation types, FEC parameters, transmission settings, guard intervals, hierarchy, and a tuner interface with methods for tuning, preparing, filtering, attaching, detaching, and state management.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A template class for iterating over a list of objects, supporting navigation and validation.

classes.name: ITuner
classes.description: An interface class for a tuner device, providing methods for tuning, state management, and filtering.

methods.name: ConvertBCD
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded byte array to a numeric value of a specified type.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes tuner support with a given configuration string.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific tuner mode is supported.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new tuner instance based on provided info.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for tuner events.
